name: unsafe fn from_raw_parts (buf : * mut u8 , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> String
rule: If buf points to a C char array containing UTF-8, constructing a String from it is normally not safe unless the array was originally allocated by the Rust standard library's allocator.
api: impl  alloc::string::String { unsafe fn from_raw_parts (buf : * mut u8 , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> alloc::string::String }
